g1.title: Add stage_snapshot_metrics() to sampled_backtest.py
g1.imperative: Add a function stage_snapshot_metrics(snapshot: StageSnapshot, actual_results: Mapping[str, int]) -> dict[str, float] to sampled_backtest.py that scores a StageSnapshot.pairwise_probability_matrix against an actual result dict (driver_id -> position). Use the same pairwise log-loss and Brier formulas as sampled_order_metrics. Extend SampledBacktestRaceResult and backtest_sampled_runtime to include per_stage_metrics: dict[str, dict[str, float]] keyed by task. Truth sources: 'quali' -> session_classifications Q, 'race_start' -> race_start_order at target_lap, 'race' -> session_classifications R (already present). Wire stage truth lookups into _oracle_state_for_mode/backtest_sampled_runtime for all 3 tasks. Unit tests in tests/unit/evo_predictor/ covering: stage_snapshot_metrics contract, correct scores against synthetic StageSnapshot, missing-truth graceful skip.

postconditions.statement: stage_snapshot_metrics() exists in sampled_backtest.py and is tested
focused unit tests pass: py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/ -k sampled_backtest -x

constraints: No changes to gold_cycle/runner.py in this gate — isolate scoring logic first

g2.title: Wire sampled-runtime backtest into gold cycle runner
g2.imperative: In gold_cycle/runner.py, after sampled_manifest assembly (~line 184), add a new step that: (1) loads the assembled sampled runtime from the manifest via sampled_runtime_from_manifest(); (2) calls backtest_sampled_runtime() twice — once with mode='sampled_state', once with mode='oracle_all_states' — over eval_year using the effective DB; (3) stores both SampledBacktestResult objects in a local variable sampled_backtest_results: dict[str, SampledBacktestResult | None] keyed by mode. Wrap each call in try/except so a single mode failure does not abort the cycle; log a warning and store None. Pass sampled_backtest_results forward to report building. Do not yet change task_calibration_diagnostics shape.

preconditions.statement: g1 complete: stage_snapshot_metrics wired and tested

postconditions.statement: gold cycle runner calls backtest_sampled_runtime for sampled_state and oracle_all_states
smoke test passes: py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/ -k gold_cycle -x

constraints: No sampled-runtime failure should abort the gold cycle — fail-safe with warning

g3.title: Route sampled-runtime scores into task_calibration_diagnostics
g3.imperative: Update build_task_calibration_diagnostics() in task_calibration.py to accept an optional sampled_backtest_results: dict[str, SampledBacktestResult | None] | None parameter. For each task (quali/race_start/race), compute per-mode aggregate metrics from the backtest results (mean across events of pairwise_log_loss_against_actual_order, pairwise_brier_against_actual_order, mean_sample_mae, expected_position_mae, event_count). Add a parallel 'sampled_runtime' key to each task entry: { 'sampled_state': { ...metrics, 'event_count': N }, 'oracle_all_states': { ...metrics, 'event_count': N } }. Absent or None results yield null metrics with event_count=0. Update runner.py to pass sampled_backtest_results to build_task_calibration_diagnostics. Unit tests covering: correct aggregation, None-safety, both modes present.

preconditions.statement: g2 complete: runner wires backtest results

postconditions.statement: unit tests pass: py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/ -k task_calibration -x

constraints: Backwards-compatible: sampled_backtest_results=None must produce same output as before for existing callers

g4.title: Update gold report schema and schema doc
g4.imperative: In gold_report_schema.py, add ReportField entries for: task_calibration_diagnostics[task].sampled_runtime, task_calibration_diagnostics[task].sampled_runtime.sampled_state, task_calibration_diagnostics[task].sampled_runtime.oracle_all_states, and each metric sub-field (pairwise_log_loss_against_actual_order, pairwise_brier_against_actual_order, mean_sample_mae, expected_position_mae, event_count) with correct type/direction/interpretation. Run write_markdown_schema() to regenerate docs/evo/gold_module_training_cycle_report_schema.md. Verify validate_documented_fields() passes on a synthetic summary/details fixture.

preconditions.statement: g3 complete: sampled_runtime key shape is final

postconditions.statement: validate_documented_fields passes on gold report with sampled_runtime fields
schema doc regenerated and committed alongside code
schema validation test passes: py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/ -k schema -x

constraints: Producer + schema doc + any registered consumers must change atomically in this gate

g5.title: Full region test suite green and gold-cycle smoke verify
g5.imperative: Run the full evo unit suite and the gold-cycle smoke/integration tests. Confirm all pass. Run: py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/ -x -q and py -m pytest tests/integration/ -x -q --timeout=300. Fix any failures introduced by this change. Confirm no regressions in sampled_backtest, task_calibration, gold_cycle, or schema tests.

postconditions.statement: no new test failures relative to pre-change baseline
